sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 50 x 38 x 160 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

AKG cut sheet for the C414 XLS and XLII (downloaded, read as text on 2026-11-12): connector 3-pin XLR (pin 2 hot), 48 V phantom power to IEC 61938 (about 4.5 mA), dimensions 50 x 38 x 160 mm, 300 g. The sheet does not say male or female: male is the convention of a microphone output (as for the other microphones of the catalogue).

build.profile (revolve-oval): station list [axial mm, width mm, depth mm] drawn from the published 50 x 38 x 160 mm only, a slab body with a wider head basket and a rounded top. No photo or drawing was opened (the AKG page answered 403): the size is exact, the shape between the stations is an ESTIMATE (confidence guess).

build.projection wrap: our own generic artwork (content/generic-panels/akg-c414-xlii.json): a mesh basket band, plain body, three small slide switches; no photo, no logo, no lettering. The XLR port is on the base at the centre (guess).
